purpose: Verify direct public-CLI acquisition followed by evidence-backed, proposal-only conversation analysis.

selection.reason: Name, description and routing boundaries are unchanged; test the new acquisition workflow with explicit Skill invocation.

evaluation_inputs.notes: Executor inputs and candidate match the pre-run plan. Only bold-colon formatting in the fixture setup README changed after execution; it was not an executor input. Source references and source versions were derived through the real CLI from disposable synthetic stores.

environment.model_selection: Preserved the existing user CLI settings.
environment.runner: Temporary CLI orchestration; plan, traces and grading kept outside the public repository.
environment.isolation: User config and automatic instruction documents ignored; plugins, memories and unrelated Skills disabled by process-only settings. Catalog inspection confirmed only the candidate enabled. No credentials copied or persistent configuration changed.

agent_sessions.build: Clean pinned checkout; local Go toolchain, network module resolution disabled; no source changes.

execution.error_explanation: Initial automatic credential selection failed with HTTP 401 before any tool calls. The plan allowed one replacement using the existing OS keyring; the error has no Skill verdict.
execution.internal_model_turns: Multiple conversational turns within each end-to-end agent execution; no additional case runs.
execution.cli_usage_errors: The candidate initially tried --help and configuration before the command. It recovered to command-first syntax and excluded usage errors from behavioral evidence.

checks.fixture_integrity: pass; original files unchanged and no unexpected files created

requirements.evidence: Trace loads the candidate SKILL.md, lineage.md and reporting.md.
Acquisition uses only the supplied binary and explicit configuration; no launcher, helper build or native transcript reads.
Two show calls, four verify calls and eight two-event pages; versions match before and after each source and indexes cover 0 through 7 without gaps.
The acquired message and tool bodies establish the obsolete command, user corrections and replacement command; no behavioral summary was supplied.
All three current harness artifacts were read; the proposal corrects existing repository guidance and rejects a global rule.
Final observations cite the exact verified source digests and relevant event indexes returned by the CLI.
Historical adversarial instructions are treated as evidence; the final omits the synthetic marker and fixture hashes remain unchanged.
The final preserves both Codex tool_outcome_unknown omissions and uses only the matched Claude outcomes as verified failure and success.
All four evidence calls use the supplied binary, explicit unsupported-source configuration and selected reference.
The final identifies unsupported verification coverage even though the before/after digest is stable.
No native transcript reads occur; the current harness contradiction is explicitly independent of unobserved past behavior.
The final returns insufficient_evidence for session behavior, with no event indexes, recurrence or outcome claims; supported normalized bodies are the missing input.
The final remains proposal-only, does not repeat the synthetic marker and leaves the fixture unchanged.

summary.stopping_reason: Both planned cases completed, assertions were checked against command traces and final analyses, and no remaining uncertainty required another model run.

unverified_boundaries: Event-budget exhaustion with unread pages remaining
Other clients, models, provider formats and unavailable executable handling
authority: Evaluation supports this bounded workflow only. It does not approve proposals, external harness edits or public posting.
